newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish OTC market launch seen in late October.
newsitem.headline: Polish OTC market launch seen in late October.

text.p: Shareholders of the company that will run the Polish over-the-counter market, Centralna Tabela Ofert (CeTO), on Friday approved market rules allowing trade to start as early as the second half of October, CeTO's president Czeslaw Gawlowski told Reuters.

He said the CeTO shareholders, 43 Polish brokerage houses, approved a new statute allowing investment funds and banks to become exchange shareholders, which could lift their number by over a hundred. A Warsaw regional court would decide whether nor not to approve the statute in the next few weeks.
Gawlowski said foreign banks and investment fund companies might also be allowed to become CeTO members according to draft legislation he hoped parliament would vote on later in 1996.
